summary: Pass ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery::safeTimezone(viewer) into the three ratio numerators. Leave claims ts, repo_date, and RecoveryTotalsBatchQuery::sharedMonthCacheKey() alone. Document the mixed clocks.

sizing.reason: One concern. The helper without the three callers is dead, and copying safeTimezone() into each card undoes the DEV-2651 extraction. Nothing here ships independently of the numerator zone.

perf_validation.reason: No new query shape. handle()/handleRange() already run per viewer zone for UniqueScanCounts and UniqueScansLeaderboard. This ticket changes the zone argument on an existing scans_cold read. Non-UTC viewers cold-miss sharedMonthCacheKey once because :tz= changes from UTC to their zone.

subtasks.title: Add numeratorZone() on RatioAgainstUniqueScans
subtasks.approach: One protected method. Read auth()->user()->timezone (the User accessor already falls back to America/Chicago when dti is empty), then return ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery::safeTimezone() of that string. Call it before any now(tz:) or Carbon::parse on the numerator path. Do not change fetchUniqueScansSeries()'s default seriesZone argument. Do not edit ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery.
subtasks.intended_diffs:
RatioAgainstUniqueScans: add protected function numeratorZone(): string that does ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery::safeTimezone((string) (auth()->user()->timezone ?? 'UTC')). Docblock: sanitise before constructing a DateTimeZone; CST/PST/+05:00 and any unlisted id (US/Central throws on construct) become UTC; the method itself must not throw.

RatioAgainstUniqueScansTest: acting as a user, assert numeratorZone() is America/Chicago for the default dti fallback, UTC for dti timeZone CST, PST, +05:00, and US/Central, and America/New_York when that IANA id is set. Invoke via reflection. No ClickHouse.

subtasks.title: UniqueLprCaseClaims numerator uses the viewer zone; claims stay UTC
subtasks.approach: getRatioMonthlyData() mints $through with now(tz: $this->numeratorZone()) and passes that zone to fetchUniqueScansSeries(). getCurrentPeriodRatio()'s today/last_7d arm mints start/end with the same day expressions as resolveCardRange(), but in numeratorZone(), and passes that zone to windowUniqueScans(). Do not feed resolveCardRange()'s raw-zone Carbon into the numerator. getMonthlyData(), labels, highlight, description, and UniqueLprCaseClaimsQuery stay on UTC. Class docblock: numerator is viewer-local; deduped claims stay UTC because AC5 is deferred so historical figures remain on Brek's Repo Report clock; the positional zip is two clocks and disagrees near a boundary. Headline UTC tests stay as they are.
